description: This file implements a Zephyr RTOS application using the zbus messaging system. It defines a confirmed message channel with multiple subscribers and listeners, and includes tasks for handling subscriber events and publishing messages in an infinite loop.

methods.name: listener_callback_example
methods.description: Callback function invoked when a message is received on the confirmed channel, logs the payload.

methods.name: bar_sub1_task
methods.description: Task handling messages for subscriber bar_sub1, reads message, sleeps, decrements user data, and logs payload.

methods.name: bar_sub2_task
methods.description: Task handling messages for subscriber bar_sub2, similar to bar_sub1_task with different sleep duration.

methods.name: bar_sub3_task
methods.description: Task handling messages for subscriber bar_sub3, similar to others with different sleep duration.

methods.name: pub_to_confirmed_channel
methods.description: Publishes a message to the confirmed channel after ensuring it is consumed, sets subscriber count.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing message and continuously publishing incremented payload messages.
